program_name: PhD in Computer Science and Informatics
evidence_role: exact doctorate and research fit
title: Computer Science and Informatics PhD Overview
evidence_summary: Official department page confirms the CSI doctorate, research rotations, thesis sequence, and relevant systems, security, information-retrieval, and machine-learning research.
limitations: Research breadth does not establish applicant admission or a current advisor opening.

program_name: PhD in Computer Science and Informatics
evidence_role: current application and preliminary support signal
title: CSI PhD Applicants
evidence_summary: Official applicant page describes the doctoral application and states that admitted students receive full tuition and competitive stipend support.
limitations: The published Fall 2026 terms are not an applicant-specific offer and must be refreshed for Fall 2027.

evidence_role: exact Computer Science doctorate and research structure
title: PhD in Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official department page confirms the PhD and its research-centered training across major computer-science areas.
limitations: The page does not establish applicant-specific admission or advisor capacity.

evidence_role: doctoral funding duration and mechanisms
title: PhD Student Resources
evidence_summary: Official resource page describes support through the fifth year and the fellowship, research, teaching, and external mechanisms used to fund students.
limitations: Stage 3 must confirm the guarantee's exact good-standing, summer, fee, and insurance conditions for a new admit.

evidence_role: exact graduate research route and assistantship signal
title: Computer Science Graduate Programs
evidence_summary: Official department page identifies the Computer Science PhD, broad faculty research, and research assistantships supporting many graduate students.
limitations: Support for many students is not a commitment to every admitted doctoral student.

evidence_role: international graduate application boundary
title: Graduate Admissions FAQs
evidence_summary: Official school FAQ provides the controlled graduate application route and international applicant requirements.
limitations: The FAQ does not establish program admission, advisor availability, or a funding package.

evidence_role: exact doctoral research and advisor structure
title: Computer Science PhD Handbook
evidence_summary: Official handbook confirms the Computer Science PhD, faculty-advised research, advisor-consent requirement, and named fellowship mechanisms.
limitations: The handbook is not a Fall 2027 funding offer and advisor consent remains applicant-specific.

evidence_role: central doctoral funding boundary
title: Aid for Doctoral Students
evidence_summary: Official GSAS page says most doctoral students receive five years of funding including fellowship, full tuition, and health-insurance benefits, and international students are considered.
limitations: The statement applies to most doctoral students and does not prove the exact Computer Science package.

evidence_role: exact doctorate, research fit, and application boundary
title: Computer Science PhD
evidence_summary: Official program page confirms the PhD, relevant software and distributed-systems areas, international application requirements, and automatic consideration of strong applicants for support.
limitations: Automatic consideration is not an assistantship or fellowship award.

evidence_role: current departmental research breadth
title: Computer Science and Engineering Research
evidence_summary: Official department page lists active software engineering, formal methods, distributed systems, machine learning, and security research groups and labs.
limitations: An active group does not establish recruitment, supervision authority, or funding.

program_name: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer/Information Science and Engineering
evidence_role: exact doctoral route and research boundary
title: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer/Information Science and Engineering
evidence_summary: Official college page confirms the research doctorate and its fellowship-consideration application timing.
limitations: Fellowship consideration is not an award, and the target Fall 2027 cycle is not yet verified.

program_name: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer/Information Science and Engineering
evidence_role: graduate funding mechanisms and departmental boundary
title: Financial Support
evidence_summary: Official Graduate School page identifies fellowships, graduate, teaching, and research assistantships while directing applicants to the admitting department for availability.
limitations: No CISE-specific guarantee, award value, or duration is established.

evidence_role: exact doctorate, advisor matching, and departmental support signal
title: Computer Science PhD Program
evidence_summary: Official department page confirms the PhD, independent research, faculty matching, Fall-only admission, and support for all students through stipend-bearing mechanisms.
limitations: The page does not state the complete duration and renewal conditions of every package.

evidence_role: school-level doctoral funding duration and package
title: Financial Assistance and Support
evidence_summary: Official Whiting page says most full-time PhD programs provide at least five years of support that may include stipend, full tuition, and health insurance.
limitations: The school-level statement allows program exceptions and requires confirmation against the CS offer terms.

program_name: Master of Science in Computer Science
evidence_role: exact thesis MSc, supervisor requirement, and preliminary package
title: Master of Science in Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official program page confirms the thesis MSc, supervisor requirement, research structure, international application route, and that most accepted students receive tuition plus partial living support.
limitations: Most is not all, and the page does not establish applicant-specific funding or total net cost.

program_name: Master of Science in Computer Science
evidence_role: current departmental research environment
title: Computer Science Department
evidence_summary: Official department page confirms the current computer-science academic and research setting supporting the MSc route.
limitations: Department activity does not establish a particular supervisor's capacity or willingness.

evidence_role: exact English MSc and research-connected software route
title: MSc Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official page confirms the Fall 2027 English 120-ECTS MSc, software technology and formal-methods pathways, research methodology, and final research or design project.
limitations: Program fit does not establish admission or scholarship selection.

evidence_role: specific prerequisites, selection, and observed admission statistic
title: Entry Requirements for Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official page specifies bachelor, mathematics, computing, and English requirements and reports 63 admissions among 762 eligible applicants for 2026.
limitations: The historical eligible-applicant rate is not an applicant-specific probability or a Fall 2027 guarantee.

evidence_role: competitive tuition scholarship boundary
title: KTH Scholarship
evidence_summary: Official scholarship page describes a full-tuition award for eligible fee-paying master's students and reports an eight-percent 2025 selection rate.
limitations: The award is highly competitive and does not cover living expenses.

evidence_role: exact English Computer Science master's
title: Master's Programme in Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official program page confirms the two-year English master's, relevant computer-science curriculum, research setting, tuition, and thesis route.
limitations: Applicant-specific prerequisite mapping and the 2027 call remain unverified.

evidence_role: tuition-waiver and living-cost boundary
title: Tuition Fees and Scholarship Programme
evidence_summary: Official admissions page describes limited 50- and 100-percent tuition waivers for fee-liable master's students.
limitations: Awards are very limited, most are partial, and living expenses are not covered.

evidence_role: exact MSc, thesis, prerequisites, and published intake context
title: MSc in Computer Science
evidence_summary: Official program page confirms the computer-science MSc, thesis route, academic requirements, relevant software and systems content, and published applicant and admission context.
limitations: Published cohort statistics do not establish an applicant-specific probability, and 2027 terms remain unverified.

evidence_role: limited government-scholarship mechanism
title: Scholarships for International Master's Students
evidence_summary: Official admissions page describes automatic consideration of eligible non-EU admits for a limited number of Danish Government Scholarships.
limitations: Coverage may be full or partial tuition and may or may not include basic living support; no award is assured.

evidence_role: exact English master's, research thesis, admission, and tuition context
title: Computer Science Master's Programme
evidence_summary: Official program page confirms the English two-year 120-ECTS master's, 63-place intake, relevant computing curriculum, tuition, scholarship mechanisms, and thesis.
limitations: Published places and support options do not establish admission or adequate funding.

evidence_role: departmental curriculum and scholarship detail
title: Computer Science MSc
evidence_summary: Official institute page describes the current master's structure, research areas, thesis preparation, and competitive financial-support opportunities.
limitations: Scholarship and DIGILINK mechanisms are selective and do not prove full net-cost coverage.
